source_statement: An interior point with more than two equal segments to distinct circumference points is the center
forward_derivation: The established III7/8 analytic equal-partner uniqueness bounds noncentral equal-distance fibers by two points. Three distinct endpoints contradict that bound. This gives p=o without requiring an interior assumption.
source_difference: Alternative analytic proof through the equal-partner theorem; stronger domain, no source cases removed. Source proof uses two perpendicular bisectors and III1 corollary.
scope_note: Three distinct endpoints represent more than two; equality is of nonnegative lengths via squared distances.
status: accepted in Session8786, not cold checked or canonical
